evidence: A calculation on products: the drainage network study's routing of the design years' rain over the redrawn floor (the first step's settled case) with the works chosen on 16 November, each weir set by routing again until the sea it serves receives its need. The routes of the cuts are found between 1.9 km cells. The climate is the present design climate on the turned Moon at 8 degrees. Not validated against any observation.
reading_rule: Levels in m above the redrawn common level; flows in m3/s; areas in km2. released is what each weir or branch lets go and arrived what reaches its sea after the lakes on the way; the salt sea and Humboldtianum are held at the common level, so their balance is nought within the weirs' setting. The near-side ocean is routed at the common level; would_settle gives the level its balance would bring it to, up to its rim, where it would join Smythii-Marginis. rivers give the long profiles of the overflows at their governed flows and of each branch from where its water runs on by itself; lakes_the_works_fill are lakes the design state without the works leaves dry or closed.
